prompt_video:
Podcast-style video. Static camera, medium close-up framing locked to the start frame throughout. She is listening, not speaking. Her mouth stays closed the entire clip, up to the very last frame. No dialogue at any point.

No captions. No background music. No camera movement or angle changes.

Realism: she keeps the exact face of the start frame and looks and moves like a real woman filmed on a real podcast, never like AI: natural blinking, visible breathing, micro-expressions in her eyes, eyebrows and cheeks, small head tilts, hands and shoulders moving with what she feels, lips always closed; real skin texture with pores, natural daylight from the side window on her face, loose hair strands that move slightly. Nothing stiff, nothing doll-like, nothing exaggerated.

REACTIONS, in this order, with a clear pause between each one:

Reacción 1: she raises her eyebrows and leans a little toward her friend, interested, with a short rising closed-mouth hum, lips sealed
Reacción 2: she drops her shoulders and lets out a slow relieved breath through her nose, lips sealed, with a small closed-lip smile
Reacción 3: she presses her lips together pulled to one side in a cheeky smirk and nods once slowly, with a tiny stifled giggle through her nose, lips pressed shut; then she holds that closed-lip smirk, silent, until the clip ends

Audio: only soft nonverbal sounds made with the lips sealed (a short hum, a relieved sigh through the nose, a stifled nasal giggle) and the room tone of a small podcast studio. No words in any language, no music.
motivo: revision de la app: Al final abrió la boca y dijo una palabra, y aquí solo debía reaccionar en silencio.
